data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 argues that centralized coordination enables synchronized global rate-limiting and load shedding to prevent cascading failures, but the problem specifically concerns CORRELATED failure, and its own countercondition concedes the orchestrator itself can be a source of correlated crashes. The evidence-distinguishing requirement of the prompt is entirely unmet: SRC_001 never identifies evidence that would separate genuinely independent failures from failures that merely appear uncorrelated until a shared cause is found. Its own SPOF countercondition is exactly a shared-cause mechanism it fails to operationalize a test for, leaving no way to distinguish apparent independence from hidden correlation.
